newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Riksbank cuts interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Riksbank cuts interest rates.

text.p: The Swedish central bank cut its deposit and lending rates by half a percentage point Thursday, prompting analysts to predict that low inflation could pave the way for further easing of the key repo rate.
The deposit and lending rates, which mark the floor and ceiling of the central bank's interest rate corridor, now stand at 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent, respectively.
The move was expected after the repo rate, the central rate in Sweden's three-tier system and key tool for controlling money market liquidity, was cut 0.25 point last week to 4.35 percent.
The Riksbank said low inflation and good prospects that prices rises would remain subdued were behind the lowering of the corridor, which was last moved Oct. 24.
